hook: How did the Disney Plus series VisionQuest episode 2 prove adamantium finally exists in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?

sections.voiceover: How did the Disney Plus series VisionQuest episode 2 prove adamantium finally exists in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
b_roll: Close up of Marvel logo transition

sections.voiceover: On October 13, Disney Plus debuted episode 2 of VisionQuest on their streaming platform. Why did assassin Paladin shoot White Vision with adamantium bullets during the sequence?
Worse yet, those adamantium bullets actually damaged White Vision during the fight.

Actor Todd Stashwick played Paladin in 18 episodes of the Disney Plus miniseries. ScreenHacker reported 2 episodes of VisionQuest premiered on October 13. Creator Terry Matalas made VisionQuest for Disney Plus as a WandaVision spin-off.
Episode 2 of VisionQuest changed cinematic history.
